title: The Restaurant With a Smaller Menu
short_teaser: A smaller menu can simplify inventory, training, quality control, and customer decisions.
story: A smaller menu can simplify inventory, training, quality control, and customer decisions. The business gives up variety in order to become more consistent at what it chooses to serve. Focused value can be more memorable than abundant choice. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust. The lesson is usually found in the decisions beneath the success story. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
